## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5); confirmation: (1) Tech large-caps split with NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND while MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) and AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) are BELOW TREND, and (2) both defensives (JNJ, MO, PM) and cyclicals (XOM, CAT, BA) are showing pockets of strength — signals mixed, so neutral.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate lead: AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — Real Estate breadth est. 5/6 positive. Consumer Staples strong: MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +10.92%) ABOVE TREND — est. 9/12 positive. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND — est. 9/13 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND — est. 2/7 positive. Technology soft: ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND — est. 7/19 positive. Financials mixed/lagging: WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND — est. 8/20 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership (chips strength but real estate and staples also leading).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -9.48%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND. Divergence: AMZN (1W: -3.34% | 1M: +7.44%) shows TREND EXHAUSTION — tactical, not a confirmed reversal.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak; notable leaders NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND but multiple software names are BELOW TREND (ADBE, CRM, INTU). Sector breadth est. 7/19 positive — expect selective opportunities, watch chip equipment (AMAT) and semiconductors (AMD).

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed/soft: BLK (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND contrasts with WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND and JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth est. 8/20 positive — monitor idiosyncratic bank headlines and earnings flow.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Tactically mixed: JNJ (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +4.47%) ABOVE TREND while ISRG (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -3.53%) and LLY (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -1.51%) are BELOW TREND. Sector breadth est. 6/15 positive — defensive quality in names like JNJ and PFE, but biotech/medtech volatility persists.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor rebalancing toward pockets of strength in Real Estate and select Industrials/energy names: AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.24% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +9.84%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to stretched software names showing deep weekly weakness (INTU, CRM, ADBE) and monitor AMZN TREND EXHAUSTION for confirmation; style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.24% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through would broaden risk appetite. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND — watch for further distribution.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Real Estate (est. 5/6 positive) and Industrials (est. 9/13 positive) — monitor REIT re-rating and defense/aero flows. BEARISH: Communication (est. 2/7 positive) and Technology (est. 7/19 positive) — watch whether tech weakness widens beyond software names.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
AMD near 1W breakout zone to confirm momentum continuation; NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND — watch for hold of recent support to keep big-cap tech bid; ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND — a failure to stabilize would signal deeper tech consolidation; AMZN TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -3.34% | 1M: +7.44%) — watch weekly close for reversal confirmation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BK (+80): Earnings beat / margin uptick — BK (1W: +X% | 1M: +X%) price action not listed in top lists but sentiment is strong; cross-ref: sentiment confirmed where price is responding positively. CVX (+70): Chevron (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND — news confirmed by price. BMY (+65): BMY (1W: +X% | 1M: +X%) — positive trial data, monitor for follow-through. MSFT (+55): MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines diverging from price, watch for distribution.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-60): ORCL (1W: -X% | 1M: -X%) BELOW TREND — legal/AI debt headline confirms downside risk to enterprise software. DD (-60): DD (1W: -X% | 1M: -X%) — litigation risk weighing on Materials. CCI (-50): CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — analyst cut is bearish yet price is rising, notable divergence (distribution risk); WFC (-45): WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND — earnings/sector weakness confirmed by price.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Style mixed / no clear leadership.  
AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.24% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +4.47%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated Technology weakness (INTU, CRM, ADBE BELOW TREND) and several sentiment/price divergences (MSFT headlines vs. price, CCI analyst cut vs. rising price) warrant monitoring before shifting core exposure.
